agent_note: Prose fiction, third-person past with a first-person strand (q02016). Signals used: no quotation marks on most quotes, so dialogue calls rest on vocatives (q02010 'Karin'), byline attribution (q02024) and quote marks where present (q02019). Event quotes are 13/13 past with no dissent. Heavy aphoristic/essayistic surface (8 gnomic) about heredity, IQ and markets -- the classic Goodreads false-present bias -- but none of it is event narration. Flagged: q02005 past-modal generalization with no story-world character; q02014/q02015/q02017 are attributed or indirect discourse whose payload is a present-tense generalization but whose narrating verb is past.
